author: Electricks94
body:
#### PR description:

PR [#49995](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49995?utm_source=gemini) introduced macros allowing custom methods to be inserted into View and ConstView classes, but this capability was strictly limited to SoABlocks layouts. This PR extends custom method support to standard SoA layouts and streamlines the SoABlocks backend so that it can use the methods macros with more parameters. This is needed because the columns macros of the standard SoA Layout class uses more parameters than the SoA_BLOCK macro. To solve this all downstram macros of the SoABlocks backend are simplified to not expand on all parameters but only on the ones that they actually need. This also simplifies the backend.

The idea of this PR was previously introduced by @leobeltra in [#48829](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/48829). In the original form SoABlocks did not exist, hence no unification needed to be done. The original PR has been closed because it was not clear at the time how functions are injected to run on heterogeneous hardware. In the meantime the backend converged to using the `SOA_HOST_DEVICE` for `SOA_ELEMENT_METHODS`, `SOA_CONST_ELEMENT_METHODS`, and for `SOA_VIEW_METHODS` and `SOA_CONST_VIEW_METHODS` used in SoABlocks. Hence, there is no reason anymore why the feature should not be used in the same way for Views of normal SoA Layouts. 

**Key Changes**

- Extended View Method Support: Standard SoA layouts can now define custom View and ConstView methods using the unified `SOA_VIEW_METHODS` and `SOA_CONST_VIEW_METHODS` macro.
- Backend Simplification: Downstream helper macros of the SoABlocks backend now explicitly extract only the parameters they actually consume, removing the legacy pattern where full, unneeded parameter tuples were blindly forwarded.

#### PR validation:

locally tested on unit test, purly technical PR

title: Implement View methods for SoA Layouts
